scope: Exact necessary-and-realized Vinberg prefix only through H<=100 for <-theta> + Lambda22 at the distinguished embedding. It proves no reflecting wall in this bounded prefix. It makes no finite-volume, compactness, reflectivity, or global nonreflectivity conclusion.

seed.complete_local_norm_proof: For primitive r=(x,y), put I=(theta*x,(y,Lambda22)). Reflection integrality gives (q(r))|2I. Away from the inert primes (2),(3), local unimodularity and primitivity force v(q)=0. The Smith diagonal 1^20,2,6 has exponent one at both discriminant primes. At (3), this gives v_3(q)<=1. At (2), an odd x makes q odd by evenness; when x is even and y is primitive, v_2((y,Lambda22))<=1 and the factor 2 in 2I permits v_2(q)<=2. Thus v_2(q) is 0,1,2 and v_3(q) is 0,1. Class number one and U^+=U^2 leave the six complete canonical norms 1,2,4,3,6,12.
